# COUI controls

Imported from MiToverG422/ONextBox third_party/coui at 64ad446594d5d864537b90a03864aafa4b59e822.
Original upstream https://github.com/suqi8/coui, Apache-2.0.

Button, icon button, switch, slider, dropdown, text field, card, preference row, navigation, divider, theme, indication and squircle sources are compiled locally.
Android expect/actual declarations are merged for this Android-only module.
COUITheme is bridged to CPI theme selection. Dynamic Monet selection remains controlled by CPI.
